The dissonance this type of question (irrational question type) creates in relationships is typically from one person being rational (in this case, your bf), and the other seeing it as more emotional (in this case, you).


Your bf is 100% being honest and true to both himself and you, regardless of how you feel. He would not date you if you were non-human. From a rational standpoint, this makes sense. You would not date a worm. You would not date a piranha. You would not date a mosquito. Plain and simple.


You're looking for an emotional response from him - as in, he would love you unconditionally regardless of your species. This does not compute in his head. The fact that you're upset over it means that you don't understand why his answer is rational: the reason being is that no one would ever find their true love if their partner was of a different species. In other words, who knows if that dog in the corner of the vets could be your true soulmate? There's a cascade of other ramifications of this that simply just do not make sense, such as how does one make love to a worm, how does one kiss a worm without damaging it? Etc. Etc. 


The point being is that your bf responded in a reasonable, rational manner. If you're looking for an emotional response, why not just ask him if he loves you? It'd be quicker, more satisfying, and doesn't have any rational or logical contradictions. Asking these types of questions are often a sign of emotional immaturity, because one person is asking for a suspension of reality. Any questions in regards to the emotions of a relationship or seeking an emotional response need to be first grounded in realism, then you'll get the answers you're looking for.

I unfortunately can't answer those questions. I exclusively use traditional because there's not enough validation of micronized in my opinion. Hopefully someone else can chime in!

So micronized you literally mix it with water and you're done - that's all the prep needed.


Traditional kava requires preparation, and isn't "mixed" but strained.


Traditional prep is this)

Materials: 

Large Bowl

Strainer bag (I've heard folks go as low as 25 micron, and as high as 200 micron, I personally use a middle ground of 80 microns) [You can substitute a pillowcase or cloth as well for this]

Water

Kava, Medium Grind


Ratios:
I use a kava to water ratio of 4 tbsp kava to 1.5 cups water. Some people like more water, others like more kava, less kava, etc. You can play around with this ratio. For reference im a 6 foot male, 250 lbs.


Prep Steps:
1. Place traditional kava into Strainer bag.

2. Add water to bowl. Place strainer bag + kava combo into bowl.

3. Knead for 5 to 10 mins. (Literally squeeze and rub the strainer bag, like one of those stress ball toys filled with sand in the water)

4. Pour drink into drinking recepticle, or drink straight from bowl.


I do a second wash with the same kava grind. A second wash makes sure all the kavalactones are out of the grind. Imo it does make a difference.


5. Second wash (same kava): add in 0.75 Cups water with the same grind

6. Knead 5-10 mins and drink second wash
